integrity: The proof uses character orthogonality and a nonzero Gauss sum to reduce all ranks to explicit three-by-three blocks. Independent finite numerical checks use 232 line configurations in 17 finite fields; finite tests alone do not establish the all-field result.
scientific_limitations: The rank theorem is for three normalized concurrent directions with the ordinary bilinear dot product; it does not classify general line triples, orthogonal spectrality, condition numbers, or other finite-field bilinear forms. Originality has only been compared with accessible publications and indexed scientific summaries; independently repeated review is not available.
title: Arithmetic sixth-root resonance for three-line Fourier sampling
